statement: A Bowl-shaped chart tends toward all placements within one half of the chart, a self-contained life oriented toward a defined project or purpose, spilling out from a sealed boundary.
editorial_note: Marc Edmund Jones' original chart-shape classification; this implementation's boundary rule is a documented computational approximation (see astrology/aspect_patterns.py), not an exact reproduction of Jones' method — a genuinely fuzzy judgment-call area even among professional astrologers.
